## Quality & Verification Checklist

- [ ] **Semantic HTML:** Markup uses valid, semantic HTML5 elements (`<header>`, `<main>`, `<nav>`, `<article>`, `<footer>`).
- [ ] **Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA):**
  - [ ] All interactive elements are fully operable via keyboard.
  - [ ] Text and interactive elements meet color contrast minimums (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text/UI components).
  - [ ] Non-decorative images have descriptive `alt` text; decorative images have empty `alt=""`.
  - [ ] Clear, visible focus indicators are present.
- [ ] **Responsive Design:** Tested and verified across desktop, tablet, and mobile viewport widths.
- [ ] **Cross-Browser:** Verified in modern browsers (Chromium, Firefox, Safari/WebKit).
- [ ] **Linting & Validation:** Markdown, YAML, and markup pass repository linters with 0 errors.
- [ ] **AI Assistance Disclosure:** If AI tools were utilized, disclosure is provided per the [AI Policy](.github/AI_POLICY.md).
- [ ] **License & Terms:** By submitting this pull request, I confirm that my contribution complies with the repository license (Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International - CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).
